jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de software incrustado
jobs_results.description:
duagon Iberia, a rapidly expanding Swiss technology company, is a leading supplier for communication, computing and control technology as well as project planning and development services for system critical applications. The superior software and hardware IP creates innovative, highly reliable and safe products, enabling customers to shape and realize their technology roadmap. Moreover, customers benefit from a shorter time to market and lower total cost of ownership.

Desde duagon Iberia estamos ampliando nuestro equipo, y buscamos un Ingeniero de Software embebido, que tenga mínimo 5 años de experiencia y que le apasione el mundo Linux.

Requisitos:
• C/C++.
• Linux.
• Bash scripting.
• Python.
• Interés en la programación a bajo nivel.

Valorable:
• Experiencia con protocolos de comunicación.
• Docker.
• C#.
• Java script.
• VxWorks.
• Experiencia con Power PC.
• Cantata.
• Rapsody.

Funciones:
• Integración de HW/SW para diferentes clientes y soluciones.
• Participación y... responsabilidad durante todo el ciclo de vida del software.
• Apoyo a los clientes en la integración de los productos de duagon en sus respectivas soluciones.
• Mantenimiento de las aplicaciones de software estándar de duagon y mejora de los entornos automatizados de construcción y pruebas.

Qué ofrecemos:
• Contrato indefinido con un paquete importante de salario flexible (tickets restaurante, cheque guardería, seguro médico…)
• Modalidad Híbrida: 1 día presencial y 4 días en remoto.
• Flexibilidad laboral con un horario competitivo.
• Carrera profesional con oportunidades de promoción.
• Actividades de Team building (BBQ, torneos de pádel…)
• Vacaciones: 23 días laborales

En duagon Iberia podrás desarrollar tu carrera en función de tus aspiraciones, crecer con nosotros y participar en nuestras interesantes iniciativas de conciliación mediante la modalidad híbrida de trabajo, formación continua y remuneración atractiva.

Si quieres saber más, visítanos en www.duagon.com

¡Únete a nuestro equipo

jobs_results.title: Software Developer, Ingeniero de Software, Ciencias de la Computación
jobs_results.description:
Nostrum Biodiscovery is a biotech company working together with several major pharmaceutical companies in Europe and the United States and has a wide knowledge of the requirements of pharmaceutical companies working in rational drug design. Nostrum’s advantages are its technologies, allowing the saving of costs and the acceleration of the whole process. Secondly, the level of calculation and prediction capacity, which directly impacts research scalability.

Lastly, the team experience and the research excellence which has been strongly demonstrated by the internationally recognized institutions that support this project for years now.
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative software developer to join our team. The primary focus of this role will be the design and development of cutting-edge methodologies for modeling nucleic acids in both their natural and non-natural forms. In this role, you will have the opportunity to coordinate the software development to... untangle exciting challenges combining in-house solutions with the integration of third-party tools.
JOB

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Managing business stakeholders to intake functional and technical requirements.
• Designing and implementing algorithms to solve specific business problems.
• Integrating software components and third-party programs into the corporate technology solution.
• Maintaining and updating existing software.
• Participating in code reviews to ensure the quality and maintainability of the codebase.
• Writing and maintaining technical documentation.
• Collaborating with other teams, such as the product management team, to understand the business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Continuously learning and staying up-to-date with new technologies for nucleic acids and software development.
REQUIRED SKILLS
• Degree in bioinformatics, chemistry, physics, mathematics, computer science, software engineering, or an adjacent field.
• Proven experience as a software developer using Python.
• Proven experience in computational biochemistry.
• Knowledge on version control systems, such as Git.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
• A willingness to continuously learn and stay up-to-date with new technologies and best practices in software development.
NICE TO HAVE
• Experience with algorithms and data structures.
• Experience with integration of software components and third-party programs, especially with applications from computational biochemistry.
• Experience with high-performance computing infrastructures.
• Knowledge of Bash.
• Familiarity with Slurm workload manager.
• Experience with testing and debugging software.
THE OFFER – WORKING CONDITIONS
• Competitive salary according to experience and Barcelona city.
• Flexible working hours and teleworking policy.
• Health care insurance included.
• Possibility to have food, transportation or nursery tickets (tax benefits).
• As part of career plan and development plans, NBD will facilitate all necessary training and future certifications to bring this role to the next level.
APPLICATION PROCEDURE

All applications must be sent using the form bellow and must include:
• A motivation letter addressed to Vito Genna.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de software
jobs_results.description:
📢 ¿Buscas un cambio, una nueva oportunidad laboral? ¿Eres una persona ágil y resolutiva? ¿Te gustaría participar en los proyectos más innovadores, recibir formación y evolucionar profesionalmente? 📢

En #VIEWNEXT (#IBM) queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo humano, a varios/as Ingenieros/as de Software, con alrededor de 5-8 años de experiencia, para participar en un proyecto de gran interés y retador a nivel profesional. Se trata de un proyecto de ámbito #internacional en el sector Pharma💊 💉

Tendrás la posibilidad de trabajar desde cualquiera de las ubicaciones con centro de trabajo VIEWNEXT y con régimen de #teletrabajo 100%, híbrido (a elegir entre 2 o 3 días a la semana) o presencial 🌐👩💻

En particular, queremos que se una a nuestro equipo alguien que tenga sólidos conocimientos 🧠 y experiencia en:
• Kubernetes/OpenShift y Java
• AWS, Azure y frameworks relacionados, como Terraform, AWS CDK, etc.
• Experiencia contribuyendo a repositorios de Git

Tendrás una gran ventaja y... contarás con un plus 👏 en caso de que tengas experiencia con:
• Jenkins
• Experiencia en redacción de pruebas automatizadas en todos los niveles de la pirámide de pruebas, idealmente utilizando el marco de Spock
• Experiencia previa en la contribución a proyectos de código abierto

🔍 Dónde aplicarás tu experiencia y conocimiento❓ Desarrollando las siguientes tareas 👇:
• Elaborarás estrategias para llevar el producto hacia el éxito con otras partes interesadas y ayudarás a transformar todas las ideas que estén en bruto en conceptos que sean comunicables y bien definidos
• Participarás en actividades de consultoría para hacer consumibles sus productos y servicios a través del EDP Marketplace
• Ayudarás a mejorar la capacidad de nuestros equipos para ejecutar y entregar en producción de forma frecuente y automática (Entrega Continua)
• Apoyarás a nuestros equipos de éxito del cliente en la resolución de problemas desafiantes y/o ayudarás a identificar soluciones alternativas adecuadas
• Se asegurará de que nuestras soluciones estén bien documentadas, probadas y cumplan con las expectativas de cumplimiento

🌟¿Por qué escoger #Viewnext?🌟

✔️ Salario competitivo 💰

✔️ Formación en Tecnología y también en 'Soft Skills' 👨🏫

✔️ Acceso a las certificaciones tecnológicas más importantes del mercado 📚

✔️ Plan de carrera, seguimiento y evaluación anual de tu desarrollo profesional 📈

✔️ Plan de retribución flexible (seguro médico, transporte, formación y guardería) 🔝

✔️ Tarjeta Restaurante para trabajadores presenciales y con modalidad híbrida 🥗☕

✔️ Programa de Teletrabajo 100% con ayuda a internet en casa 💶

✔️ Horario de 9:00h a 18:00h con flexibilidad de entrada y salida ⏰

✔️ Jornada de Verano del 1 Julio al 15 de septiembre 🏖

✔️ Buen ambiente de trabajo, innovador, abiertos e inclusivos 🤗💙

Si estás interesad@ no dudes en #inscribirte en nuestra #oferta para poder contarte más detalles de este proyecto. Si bien a ti no te interesa, pero crees que a una persona que conoces sí, envíale el enlace de esta #oportunidad laboral, puedes ayudarle a dar el cambio que desea o darle ese último empujón para que por fin crezca en su carrera profesional!

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer (Java) 100% remote and 4 days working week...
jobs_results.description:
Join Our Team as a Software Engineer!

Join us as a Senior Back-End Developer and dive into the heart of web application architecture! Your mission? To craft, shape, and maintain the behind-the-scenes magic that powers our digital experiences.

Here's the lowdown on what you'll be up to:

About Us

IriusRisk is like the superhero of threat modeling and secure software design 🔒. We're all about spotting vulnerabilities before they become a problem. Our platform makes threat modeling a breeze, empowering developers to create software that's not just awesome but also super secure, even at scale!

Purpose of the Role

Picture this: you'll be the mastermind behind the scenes, designing, developing, and nurturing the server-side logic and infrastructure of our web apps. Your job is to make sure everything runs smoothly, integrates seamlessly, and performs like a champ. Oh, and did we mention you get to work with a bunch of cool folks across teams to make it all happen?

Duties ... Responsibilities

You're the Java guru, breathing life into our applications with your code magic. You'll brainstorm with the product team, hash out objectives, and make dreams a reality. Group meetings? Yep, you'll be there, sharing ideas, cracking jokes, and making awesome plans. And when it's time to roll up your sleeves and get coding, you'll do it with style, using agile methods and crafting clean, elegant solutions.

What we are offering?

🌴 4 days working week!

📍 100% remote working.

🕺🏻 Excellent working environment.

🔑 Work with a bunch of really nice, highly qualified professionals with world-class references in the Threat Modeling sector.

🔭 Real career development opportunities within the company.

🎯We focus on the 'Do it well' culture and are not afraid to invest in doing things right the first time.

📚 Training And Qualifications Related To Your Role.

♾️ Horizontal business culture

Requirements:

Essential Skills And Experience
• Got a Bachelor's or Master's in computer science or a related field? Check.
• Solid 4 years' experience with Java, Spring, and Hibernate? Double check.
• You're a code-testing pro, know your design patterns inside out, and breathe life into POO like nobody's business.

Nice to have

But wait, there's more! If you're savvy with React, PostgreSQL, or navigating the gitflow workflow, you're our hero.

Microservices architecture, OAuth 2.0, and RESTful services? Yeah, we're into that too.

We're not just looking for a code ninja; we want someone who's got the whole package.

Problem-solving? Check.

Attention to detail? Absolutely.

Communication skills that can charm the socks off anyone? You betcha.

Plus, you're a team player, a time-management whiz, and as adaptable as a chameleon at a rainbow convention.

But that's not all. We're all about growth here, so bring your appetite for learning, your professionalism, and your troubleshooting skills.

Oh, and did we mention patience? You'll need plenty of that too. And hey, a constructive mindset? Yeah, that's a must.

So, if you're ready to take on the challenge, dive into the deep end of back-end development, and join a team that's all about innovation and excellence, hit us up. We can't wait to meet you

jobs_results.title: Tech Lead, Ingeniero de Software, Ciencias de la Computación
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Tech Lead at Vue School (full-time)
Location: Sanz

Hello! We are Bitter Brains, the company behind the popular learning platforms Vue School and Mastering Nuxt . We are also proud organizers of Vue.js events, including Nuxt Nation , Vue.js Nation , and Vue Forge . This year, we launched the Official Vue.js Certification program, in partnership with Evan You and the Vue.js team. Since 2016, we've had the privilege of helping over 160,000 students learn Vue.js

and other web technologies and creating an online community of 500,000 developers. We take pride in making education accessible and available everywhere around the world. Our mission is to continue spreading knowledge and making developers’ life easier.
The position

We are looking for a talented and experienced hands on Technical Team Lead to manage the remote software engineering team and troubleshoot technical issues that involve software development, engineering tasks and product releases. This role requires you to... develop alongside the team management duties. It’s a hybrid dev / manager position.

You will oversee the development team and all projects they undertake, analyze briefs, identify risks, and manage agile delivery whilst contributing in a development capacity. You should be able to work with your team and inspire them to reach their goals.

You should always be expanding your industry knowledge and be able to quickly identify problems. You will recommend new technologies, processes and tools to enhance development capabilities. Outstanding technical leads are accountable, trustworthy, and able to build lasting relationships with their teams, leading from a practical perspective.

The position is 100% remote and you can apply from anywhere in the world, as long as you have availability to work full-time (8 hours), sharing around 4 hours with the office day of the CET timezone.
Technical Lead

Duties and

Responsibilities
• Lead and manage the smooth functioning of technical operations, providing technical direction and guidance for solution delivery
• Monitor and evaluate staff progress and assist with training and recruitment
• Delegating tasks and achieving daily, weekly, and monthly goals.
• Motivating staff and creating a space where they can ask questions and voice their concerns.
• Oversee technical estimations for project plans and timelines, ensuring projects are completed on timeand on budget
• Manage work schedules for the team to support optimal delivery
• Work closely with product management, customer support, and marketing, to ensure all product roadmapand technical requirements are met
• Support development teams to refine data and functional requirements
• Provide technical expertise and guidance to unblock the team and ensure quality standards are met
• Collaborate with Product to understand customer requirements and develop technical solutions to meet customer needs
• Develop features using Vue.js, Laravel, and other technologies.
• Develop and document technical processes and procedures
• Participate in testing phases
• Keeping up-to-date with industry trends and developments.
Requirements
• 5+ years of experience in software development and technical leadership for the following or similar technologies:
• expertise in integrating REST APIs with web applications.
• Experience in working and managing remote teams.
Nice to have
• Experience with integrating CRMs, like customer.io.
• Experience with GTM or similar tools.
• Experience with deployment process using Laravel Forge and Netlify.
• Experience working for e-learning platforms.
• Experience working with data analytics
What we offer
• Work for a brand users love!
• Work with cutting-edge technologies.
• Full-time remote position on a long-term contract basis.
• Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
• Flexible paid time off for work-life balance.

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, Agile
jobs_results.description:
#hybrid - Barcelona We are looking for a software engineer to join our life science team in Barcelona. This is an amazing opportunity to work on OFF-X product. The team consists of 6 developers and 2 QA and is reporting to the team lead software engineering. The Software Engineer will work as part of a cross-functional team to architect and deliver high-quality software in an agile environment.

We are looking for an engineer to contribute to development efforts on the back-end side of our application.

About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments 2+ years industry experience in full-stack software development.

Experience developing and designing backend RESTful services.

Experience with Java and Spring Boot for backend services.

Proficiently working with Elasticsearch or other similar search engines to handle data retrieval.

Experience writing/optimizing SQL queries for relational databases (e.g., Oracle DB)

Experience of working within an Agile delivery... environment.

Good knowledge and understanding of Version Control tools (preferably Git)
Knowledge and experience of working within a microservices architecture.

Familiarity with Jenkins and AWS services are preferred.

It would be great if you also had . . . Experience running services in docker.

Experience using Jenkins.

Knowledge about AWS cloud infrastructure.

Experience with Angular What will you be doing in this role?

Take a role implementing our backend services.

Work as a backend software engineer in a cross-functional team.

Write quality, well-tested, documented code.

Adhere to development best practices and standards as set within the team.

Help support existing systems, diagnosing issues, and identifying bugs.

Work closely with QA, Dev Ops, Product Owners, Solution Analysts and Project Management.

Product you will be developing

Our end to end SaaS solutions focus on drug safety, allowing our customers to streamline their literature review process and generate a variety of time-critical reports . These systems facilitate a key process in the lifecycle of pharma products for our customers around the world.

About the Team The development team based in Barcelona consists of 6 Software Engineers and 2 QA Engineers, plus the Team Lead Software Engineering.

You will be working closely with the Solution Analyst and Product Owner helping to shape the scope and the refinements as part of the Agile processes and ceremonies.

Hours of Work Full time employee, 40 hour per week. Hybrid work environment (2 days per week working from office and the rest can work from home)
What we can offer you:

A start up culture/working environment combined with all the financial and stability advantages of working for a publicly traded company.

An opportunity to have a real impact on the global Life Sciences industry.
30 working days of vacation

Volunteering community, with 40 paid hours of volunteering time Private Health and Life & Disability insurances.

Tax-free benefits (Ticket Restaurant scheme, kindergarten, and transport cards)
At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

Summary

Location:

Spain - Barcelona Type:
Full time
